sections.headline: Thoroughly Gentle Yet Incredibly Fast
disclaimers: *Product images are for illustrative purpose only and may differ from actual product.

assets.alt: The washing machine is working against the background of the father and daughter laughing.

sections.headline: Intelligent Care with 18% More Fabric Protection
sections.body: AI DD™ offers optimized wash to protect your laundry by sensing fabric softness automatically.
disclaimers: *The product images in the image and video are for illustrational purposes only and might differ from the real product.

*Tested by Intertek on March 2019. Cotton cycle with 2kg of underwear compared to LG Conventional Cotton cycle(F4V9RWP2W vs. FC1450S2W). The results may be different depending on the clothes and environment.
*AI DD is available in 3 cycles.(Cotton, Mixed Fabric, Easy Care).

assets.alt: White cloth is being washed in the washing machine.

sections.headline: Thoroughly Clean in 39 minutes
sections.body:
With TurboWash™360˚, your laundry can be thoroughly done in just 39 minutes with more fabric protection. 4 directions of 3D multi nozzles which reaches every inch of your laundry.
Play videoPause video
Triple A
disclaimers: *The product images in the image and video are for illustrational purposes only and might differ from the real product.

*Tested by Intertek, based on IEC 60456 : edition 5.0. TurboWash39 cycle with 5kg of IEC load compared to Conventional Cotton Cycle with TurboWash (F4V9RWP2W vs. FC1450S2W). The results may be different depending on the environment.

assets.alt: Water flows out of the washing machine in four directions and is doing laundry.
There are 3 A's on the stage in front of the world map background.

sections.headline: Experience Triple A benefits of LG Washing Machine
sections.body: Marked "Triple A" for energy efficiency, spinning performance, and noise level.
disclaimers: **Energy Efficiency**

sections.headline: Less Wrinkles, More Hygienic
sections.body:
Steam+™ reduces 99.9% dust mites that can cause respiratory issues with 30% less wrinkles.
Play videoPause video

assets.alt: Less Wrinkles, More Hygienic3
There is laundry in the washing machine, and steam is running.

sections.headline: 30% Less Wrinkles
sections.body: The wrinkles are disappeared through the steam.

assets.alt: There are shirts with half wrinkled and half less wrinkled.

sections.headline: Eliminates 99.9% of Dust Mites
sections.body: 99.9% of dust mites are eliminated by the steam.
disclaimers: *The product images in the image and video are for illustrational purposes only and might differ from the real product.
*The Allergy Care cycle approved by the BAF (British Allergy Foundation) eliminates 99.9% of dust mite allergens.

*Tested by Intertek in December 2018 in accordance with AATCC standard. Cotton cycle with the “Wrinkle Care" option (3 mixed shirts) compared to the cotton cycle without option. Results may be different depending on clothes and environment.
*The Wrinkle Care function is optionally available in 6 cycles.

assets.alt: Half are contaminated and the other half are clean baby clothes.

sections.headline: Bigger Capacity in the Same Space
sections.body: Get bigger drum capacity in same size﻿!
disclaimers: *The product images in the image and video are for illustrational purposes only and might differ from the real product.

assets.alt: A washing machine, expressed as a large capacity, is in front of the laundry basket image.

sections.headline: More Durable and Hygienic
sections.body:
Boosted externals, durable tempered glass door, developed hygienic and enduring stainless lifter.
- Tempered Glass Door
- Stainless Lifter (99% Anti Bacteria\*)
- Larger Display
disclaimers: *The product images in the image and video are for illustrational purposes only and might differ from the real product.
*Tested by Intertek on July 2013. Bactericidal effect for P.aeruginosa of stainless steel against initial amount in 12 days.

assets.alt: More Durable and Hygienic3
The inside image of the washing machine where the Stainless Lifter can be seen.
This is an enlarged image of the washing machine panel so that the display can be clearly seen.

assets.alt: This is an enlarged image of the metal knob on the panel of a washing machine.
assets.title: Design

sections.headline: More Visible and Elegant
sections.body: Made a more visible display and increased the knob size.
disclaimers: *Product images are for illustrative purpose only and may differ from actual product.

assets.alt: The image of the washing machine with the Tempered Glass Door clearly visible.

sections.headline: Available with TWINWash™ Mini
sections.body: Plus a TWINWash™ Mini according to your preferences to suit your lifestyle and interior design needs. Save you time and money in your busy life.
disclaimers: *Product images are for illustrative purpose only and may differ from actual product.
*TWINWash™ Mini may not be available in all country or in all local retailers.

assets.alt: Three interior photos with twinwash and washing machine.
A woman sitting on the couch and drinking tea is giving orders to her washing machine through her AI speaker.

sections.headline: Simple Control with Voice Assistant
sections.body: Tell your washer exactly what you need, when you need it. Say, “What cycle is the washer?” and the AI speaker will listen and check the cycle to let you know.

assets.alt: A man is monitoring the condition of the washing machine through a mobile phone app.
A man is monitoring the condition of the washing machine through a mobile phone app.

sections.headline: Connect and Control from Anywhere
sections.body: The LG ThinQ® app allows you to easily connect with your washer in a way you never could before. Start your washer with just the tap of a button.

assets.alt: A woman sitting on the couch and drinking tea is giving orders to her washing machine through her AI speaker.

sections.headline: Efficient Product Maintenance
sections.body: Check the status of the washer, download new cycles, or monitor energy usage with LG ThinQ®.
